events.input: $ cd [redacted]; for f in probe-onboarding-tabs probe-headings probe-details; do grep -n -m3 -E "localhost|BASE|process.argv|process.env" scripts/$f.mjs; done; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E "node|next" | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u; node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4

events.input: $ cd [redacted]; grep -n '"dev"\|"start"' package.json; for p in 4322 4361; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; grep -n "4322\|4361" ../.claude/launch.json | head

events.input: $ cd [redacted]; (node scripts/probe-headings.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4); echo ---; (node scripts/probe-onboarding-tabs.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4); echo ---; (node scripts/probe-details.mjs 2>&1 | grep -i -E "fail|✗|pass|summary" | tail -12)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read interim probe output and see which probe is running
events.input: $ cat [redacted].output; ps aux | grep "scripts/probe" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $12,$13, $10}'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for the details probe to finish and show its result
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 55); do pgrep -f "scripts/probe-details" >/dev/null || break; sleep 10; done; pgrep -f "scripts/probe-details" >/dev/null && echo STILL_RUNNING; tail -c 1500 [redacted].output

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun the details probe with a full log and inspect progress after four minutes
events.input: $ pkill -f "scripts/probe-details"; cd [redacted]; (node scripts/probe-details.mjs > /tmp/t191-details.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 240; wc -l /tmp/t191-details.log; grep -c -i "ok" /tmp/t191-details.log; grep -n -i -E "fail|✗|error" /tmp/t191-details.log | cut -c1-300 | head -20; tail -5 /tmp/t191-details.log | cut -c1-300; pgrep -f "scripts/probe-details" >/dev/null && echo STILL_RUNNING
